verdict.rationale: Pomelo documents an API for authorizing and adjusting transactions with your own authorizer instead of Pomelo's credit core [pomelo-docs-18], which implies your code makes the real-time approve/decline decision. It also offers a stand-in feature where Pomelo authorizes transactions when your services are slow to respond [pomelo-docs-7], with reversals and refunds delivered via an adjustments endpoint [pomelo-docs-28]. Each is only a one-line guide summary, so the mechanics are unproven. Missing for 10: documented response time budget/timeout value, details on configuring the fallback rules you control, request/response schema for the authorization callback, independent or hands-on corroboration.
